CHECK_FOR_UPDATES_ON_STARTUP_TIP: Checks for a new Charlotte release each time the app opens.
DEFAULT_AUDIO_TIP: All audio tracks are muxed. The selected audio language will be set as default option.
DEFAULT_SUBTITLE_TIP: All subtitles are muxed. The selected subtitle language will be set as default option.
AUDIO_CODEC_TIP: Flac is lossless, the best default option for archival purposes. Opus is 256 kbps VBR and is 3-5x smaller in size while perceptually transparent, but is still lossy technically.
SKIP_EXISTING_TIP: Skips any file whose .mkv is already in the output folder. Useful for resuming an interrupted batch.
FLAT_OUTPUT_TIP: Writes each .mkv straight into the output folder instead of giving every cutscene its own subfolder.
KEEP_INTERMEDIATES_TIP: Leaves the decrypted intermediate files (.ivf, .hca, and .ass) on disk after muxing, instead of deleting them.
APPLY_VAPOUR_SYNTH_TIP: Enable VapourSynth filtering to fix video artifacts (mostly banding) due to Hoyo's poor encoding. Very slow and heavy on CPU, can take up to an hour, varied by video length.
HARD_SUB_TIP: Burn the subtitle into the video. Good for when you're using it somewhere that doesn't support soft subtitles. Re-encodes the video with the x265 settings to the right. No soft subtitles will be muxed.
CRF_TIP: x265 quality, 0 to 51. Lower is better in quality and bigger in size.
PRESET_TIP: x265 speed against efficiency. Slower presets take longer for a smaller file at the same quality.
X265_PARAMS_TIP: Built-in tuning for the preset. 'ultrafast' to 'medium' uses the same neutral tuning parameters that improve picture quality without affecting encode speed. 'slow' to 'placebo' uses the same but with added parameters for better quality.
RESET_TO_DEFAULTS_TIP: Reset all settings to default. Click on OK to confirm the changes.

CAPTURE_INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Click "Start" to start capturing packets.
2. Start Genshin Impact and enter the door.
3. Once the data has been captured, stop the capture and copy it to the clipboard.
